armDescription: not an arm. Arms A, B and C name ways of RUNNING a scenario, and nothing was run here — this directory was written by hand, in the four-file shape bench/replay.js reads.

derived.what: A deterministic replay model of the PID-reuse / millisecond-identity bound. Two modelled process generations, A and B, share one pid and one stored birth millisecond, so they share one instanceId; they differ only in a generation witness finer than that millisecond.
derived.notReproduced: Windows PID reuse inside one millisecond was NOT reproduced, and cannot be forced deterministically. No process was created, no sensor ran, no audit chain was read.
derived.notAMeasurement: No number here is an accuracy figure, a collision rate, or Sysmon-confirmed evidence. The report this input produces is a characterisation of what a pid-only join can and cannot establish, and nothing else.
derived.reportRendererAbsent: This input carries no reportRenderer block because no renderer ever produced a report for it — it ships no run-report.json at all. bench/replay.js therefore classifies it legacy-unversioned, which is the honest reading: there is no recorded renderer identity to compare against.
